measurementType: image preparation cache, main-thread conversion, and pre-registration deadline boundaries

observed.cachedImages: Expired deadlines and stale item checks fail before ready; rejected hits do not decode, change cache byte/entry counts, or refresh LRU recency.
observed.mainThreadBgraConversion: The original absolute deadline is checked after image service completion and again after RGBA-to-BGRA conversion.
observed.providerSnapshot: The same deadline is checked after snapshot completion and before helper registration; a late snapshot is released.

limitations: Image service, provider, and clock are fakes; main orchestration functions are exercised in a VM harness with a synthetic 1x1 image.

This evidence proves fail-closed guards before helper registration in the harness, not real decoder CPU interruption, real OS clipboard/provider behavior, helper lifecycle, or a full desktop selection/paste flow.
The T04 P15 content-provider decode/hash path remains outside scope per user direction; JPEG 4:2:0 fidelity and full T04 acceptance remain open.
